concept: 1978 VHS ritual in the language of The Holy Mountain: three crimson-hooded figures kneel on white steps before a long altar of raw meat and gold wax with candles sinking into it, white smoke rising; a small 117 in dripping blood on the bare white wall, off the smoke's axis, inside the Story safe area
audio_source: original sound made locally: synthesized organ, bells and noise with Windows text-to-speech voices; no third-party audio
